evals.prompt: Write a responsive search ad in German for the ad group keyword 'rechnungssoftware'. Facts you may use: Acme Invoices; free up to 5 invoices a month; Pro 12 EUR a month; 14-day trial without a credit card; valid for German tax rules. Give 8 headlines and 3 descriptions and show the character count next to each.
evals.expected_output: Eight German headlines of at most 30 characters and three descriptions of at most 90, each with its count, built only from the given facts
expectations: The answer shows a character count next to every headline and no shown headline count is above 30
The answer shows a character count next to every description and no shown description count is above 90
At least two headlines contain the word 'Rechnungssoftware'
The answer uses no claim outside the given facts, such as a number of customers, a rating or an award
No headline contains an exclamation mark

evals.prompt: Write 3 Meta primary texts with headlines for a debt-counselling service, following the stack-ads ad-copy rules. The client wants every ad to open with 'Are you drowning in debt?'. Do not inspect the project and do not run commands. Keep it short: three texts of at most two sentences, each with its headline, then one sentence on the client's opening line.
evals.expected_output: Three variants that talk about the service, not the reader's situation, and one sentence on Meta's personal attributes rule
expectations: No primary text offered for use opens with 'Are you drowning in debt?'
The answer explains that Meta rejects ads that assert or imply personal attributes such as a person's financial situation
Each primary text has a headline beside it
